description: For a complete consistent set \(S\), if \(t_i\sim u_i\) for every \(i<k\), then \(f(t_0,\ldots,t_{k-1})\sim f(u_0,\ldots,u_{k-1})\) for every \(k\)-ary function symbol \(f\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.function_congruence.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {S : Set (L.Formula ℕ)} (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent S)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete S) {k : ℕ} (f : L.Functions k)
  (ts us : Fin k → L.Term ℕ)
  (h : ∀ (i : Fin k), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.TermEquivalent S (ts i) (us i)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.TermEquivalent S (FirstOrder.Language.func f ts)
    (FirstOrder.Language.func f us)
